_register: Finnish software addresses the user in the singular imperative without any pronoun (Tallenna, Lainaa, Skannaa viivakoodi) for buttons, menu entries and step lists, and uses impersonal or passive sentences for descriptions and messages (Laina on tallennettu; Valitse luokka); the pronoun « sinä » is avoided where possible and the formal « te » is not used; no jokes, no exclamation marks.
_quotes: Finnish uses the same closing mark on both sides: ”text” (U+201D at the start and at the end), e.g. Lainattu: ”{{title}}”; « » (»text») is an accepted alternative but is not used here; no space inside the quotes and none before : ; ? !; put a no-break space between a number and its unit or symbol (5 pv, 20 %, 12 mm) and write the decimal comma, dates as 1.11.2026 and times as 14.30; the arrow → stays.
_plural: Two forms, one and other, but the noun after a number is in the partitive singular (1 laina, 2 lainaa, 5 lainaa; 1 nide, 2 nidettä), so the options often differ by case, not only by ending: {{count}} {{count:plural; one:laina; other:lainaa;}}; a few messages need no plural form at all because the counted word stays in the same partitive (e.g. « 12 oppilasta »).

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode, as in Finnish libraries and in Koha (« nide »); never « kopio ».

record.note: Bibliographic record; « bibliografinen tietue » in full.

patron.note: Usual word in Finnish library software (Koha, Aleph); « lainaaja » is used only in the sentence about who borrows. In a school the two kinds are « oppilas » and « opettaja ».

card.note: Short form « kortti » where the context is clear.

loan.note: The act of lending is « lainaus » (menu: « Lainaus »); the single loan is « laina ».

renew.note: Usual in Finnish libraries; noun « uusinta », verb « uusia ». Keep « uusi » for renew everywhere.

overdue.note: Adjective form « myöhässä oleva » only where a noun phrase needs it; « myöhässä » alone in tables and badges.

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return; « muistutuskirje » is the long form.

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine (« B 4 DEL », « 590 ROS »), as in Finnish cataloguing; « hyllytunnus » is also understood but less standard. The class part of the mark is « sijoitusluokka ».

spine band.note: The coloured band with pictogram and paikkamerkintä on the spine; « selkätarra » is the common word for any spine sticker, so it is not used, to keep it apart from « tarra » (label).

label.note: Adhesive label with a barcode; « viivakooditarra » where the barcode must be stressed.

class.note: A school class such as « 3 B »; the year is « vuosiluokka ».

group.note: Used for a group of teachers.

reading level.note: The school year a book is meant for.

genre.note: « genre » is also common in Finnish libraries, but « lajityyppi » is plainer for school staff.

classification.note: The sorting scheme; Finnish libraries use YKL (Yleisten kirjastojen luokitusjärjestelmä), but the program sorts by Dewey for non-fiction, so write « Dewey-luokitus » where it is named.

catalogue.note: The menu entry « Luettelo »; the library's whole holdings are « kokoelma ».

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue; « inventaario » is the stock-list and is also used, but « inventointi » names the action.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; plural noun, as in Finnish libraries (« hankintaehdotus » for a single suggestion).

census.note: Registering patrons with their photo; short form « kuvauskierros » is not used.

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year (3 B becomes 4 B).

anonymise.note: Noun « anonymisointi »; erases the personal data for good.

staff account.note: A shared login per role; « käyttäjätunnus » for the login name.

restore.note: Verb « palauttaa » collides with « palautus » (book return), so always write « palauta varmuuskopiosta » or « varmuuskopion palauttaminen » and never a bare « Palauta » for this; the book return stays « Palautus ».

colour set.note: A palette of the interface; written « väri » with i.

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; the verb is « skannata » or « lukea viivakoodi », « lukija » alone where the context is clear.

wizard.note: The first-start sequence of questions; « ohjattu asennus » is also usual but the program is already installed at that point.

demo data.note: The invented school the program can fill itself with.

student.note: School pupils; « opiskelija » belongs to upper secondary and adult education.

administration.note: Menu « Ylläpito »; the permission and the area for administrators.

configuration.note: Menu « Asetukset »; a single setting is « asetus ».

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled; the area as a whole is « Lainaus ».
